Resolves #17791

Removes the received Agent OS implementation from Neo and leaves an Engine-only package/runtime surface. The retained Fleet Manager and Neural Link whitebox tests now load their server-side modules only from an explicit absolute `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`; there is no Engine cwd fallback and no Engine dependency on `neo-agent-brain`.

Evidence: L3 required. The physical cut, install/build/test/package behavior, and cross-repository binding are runtime claims.

## AC Evidence

| Acceptance area | Evidence at `cde25640cc` |
|---|---|
| Agent OS implementation removed | Zero tracked `ai/**`; 839 source paths deleted. |
| Brain unit tests removed | Zero tracked `test/playwright/unit/ai/**`; 789 unit-AI paths deleted. |
| Integration custody moved | 54 integration, 3 integration-parity, and the Brain test adapter removed from Engine. |
| Guides moved | 111 Agent OS guides and 6 Brain benefit guides removed; Engine identity/docs point to `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`. |
| Engine package boundary | All `ai:*`, Brain install, and Brain integration scripts removed; Brain-only dependencies removed from `package.json` and lock. |
| CI and hooks | 23 Brain/AI workflows, 7 Brain hook implementations, and their registrations/specs removed; Engine CI retains unit/components and Engine guards. |
| External whitebox binding | Fleet/Neural Link retained tests use `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`; missing/non-absolute binding fails without cwd recovery. |
| Stay set | `src/ai/**`, Engine apps, Fleet Manager, harness, public clients/contracts, and Engine-owned tests remain. |

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge — one gap, and it is not yours to fix.**

`test/playwright/unit/harness/terminateDaemon.spec.mjs` is deleted here, and `neo-agent-brain` does not have it at any path. At first read that looked like an out-of-scope harness deletion, since harness custody is Fleet Manager's under #17805. It is not — the spec's subject is not a harness module:

```js
} from '../../integration/helpers/terminateDaemon.mjs';
```

Its subject is `test/playwright/integration/helpers/terminateDaemon.mjs`, which this PR correctly removes and which **is present in Brain**. So deleting it from the Engine is right; what is missing is that the spec did not follow its subject across. `terminateDaemon.mjs` is now covered in neither repository.

**Required action on this PR: none.** The fix belongs to `neo-agent-brain` — the spec wants to land there beside the helper it exercises. I am routing it to @neo-gpt-emmy rather than holding your merge for it.

Worth one line because it is the same lesson twice today: that spec sat under `unit/harness/` while testing an `integration/helpers/` module. **Filed by directory, not by subject** — which is exactly how it and its subject came to be disposed separately. The subject rule ADR 0040 §2.7 applies to test placement too, and a spec whose folder disagrees with its import is the cheap tell.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit:** N/A — a removal diff with no architectural prose.
